name: KB-TutorBench
summary: A planned dataset of about 6,000 annotated tutoring dialogues from simulated and real classrooms in science, ELA and history, with fine-tuned tutoring models.

license.note: Stated intent: the dataset under CC BY 4.0 and the code under Apache 2.0; no license is named for the model weights.

access_note: Planned on Hugging Face and GitHub.
cite: Stanford University. KB-TutorBench: A Multimodal Knowledge-Building Dataset for AI-Enabled Formative Assessment. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project, https://k12-ai-infrastructure.org/stanford-university/
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.

fits.how: Its annotated dialogues could become agent test cases and check a judge against people's ratings.
